meta.title: SSO / SAML 2.0: on failure — admin alerted
gaps: Configure the INT-003 SSO/SAML 2.0 inbound integration with the specified provider, entity ID, SSO URL, certificate, and role mapping
Make the external SAML provider fail or become unreachable
Trigger a Procol user login attempt through SAML
Verify the administrator is alerted and that the failure produces the named state, alert, log, or retry record without being silently dropped
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Configure the INT-003 SSO/SAML 2.0 inbound integration with the specified provider, entity ID, SSO URL, certificate, and role mapping; Make the external SAML provider fail or become unreachable; Trigger a Procol user login attempt through SAML; Verify the administrator is alerted and that the failure produces the named state, alert, log, or retry record without being silently dropped

args.need: configure INT-003 SSO/SAML 2.0 inbound integration, make the external provider fail or become unreachable, trigger a Procol SAML login attempt, and verify the admin alert plus visible failure or retry evidence

steps.note: The catalog cannot configure integrations, control an external identity provider, perform the required SAML failure trigger, or inspect the resulting admin alert and retry/log evidence.
Check that the browser session has no crash or server error after the tester completes the external-flow investigation; this does not assert the SSO alert behavior.
